verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials describe fleet-wide real-time telemetry and status in a single operator view: "Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet", "Manage multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view", and "One view across every vendor's fleet". Its orchestration page tracks "current location and status" per robot, and analytics dashboards can span a fleet by device group or tag. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a fleet map or location view inside the monitoring dashboard (location is only mentioned on the orchestration page), explicit health indicators beyond telemetry and anomaly alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can monitor the health, location, and status of a whole robot fleet from one dashboard

citations.quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet. Configurable alerts and automated incident detection
Manage multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view
One view across every vendor's fleet — AMRs, quadrupeds, humanoids, arms — without a separate dashboard, update cycle, or incident format per manufacturer.
Get instant visibility into every robot in your fleet.
You can analyze from an individual device, or from a fleet of devices by device group or tag.
